description: Benchmark comparison: polkadot-rest-api vs substrate-api-sidecar — offline results from wrk + resource_monitor

targets.rawQueryText: WITH r AS (SELECT rps, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rps) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER () as cnt FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' AND service LIKE '%rest-api%') SELECT ROUND(AVG(rps),1) as median_rps FROM r WHERE rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1)

WITH r AS (SELECT rps, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rps) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER () as cnt FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' AND service='sidecar') SELECT ROUND(AVG(rps),1) as median_rps FROM r WHERE rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1)

WITH r AS (SELECT p99_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p99_ms) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER () as cnt FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' AND service LIKE '%rest-api%') SELECT ROUND(AVG(p99_ms),1) as median_p99 FROM r WHERE rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1)

WITH r AS (SELECT p99_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p99_ms) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER () as cnt FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' AND service='sidecar') SELECT ROUND(AVG(p99_ms),1) as median_p99 FROM r WHERE rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(peak_rss_mb),1) FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' AND service LIKE '%rest-api%'
SELECT ROUND(MAX(peak_rss_mb),1) FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' AND service='sidecar'

panels.title: RPS per Run — higher & tighter is better
panels.description: Each bar is one benchmark run. Shows consistency across runs.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN rps END), 1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN rps END), 1) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Request Duration (Median) per Run — lower is better
panels.description: Median request duration from each run. Lower and tighter is better.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_latency_ms END), 1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN avg_latency_ms END), 1) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Max Request Duration per Run — single slowest request
panels.description: Slowest single request in each run. Shows worst-case tail latency.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN max_latency_ms END), 1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN max_latency_ms END), 1) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_latency_ms END), 1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN avg_latency_ms END), 1) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Transfer Rate (Median) — higher is better
panels.description: Data throughput in MB/s. Higher is better — measures how much response data the API can push per second.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH r AS (SELECT service, transfer_per_sec, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY transfer_per_sec) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY service) as cnt FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}') SELECT 'Median' as metric, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN transfer_per_sec END) / 1048576.0, 2) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN transfer_per_sec END) / 1048576.0, 2) as "sidecar" FROM r WHERE rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1)

panels.title: Avg Response Size (Median) — similar means apples-to-apples
panels.description: Average bytes per response. Similar values across services means apples-to-apples comparison.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH r AS (SELECT service, CASE WHEN total_requests > 0 THEN bytes * 1.0 / total_requests ELSE 0 END as resp_size, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_requests > 0 THEN bytes * 1.0 / total_requests ELSE 0 END) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY service) as cnt FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}') SELECT 'Median' as metric, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN resp_size END), 0) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN resp_size END), 0) as "sidecar" FROM r WHERE rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2+1)

panels.title: Latency Percentiles — rest-api vs sidecar
panels.description: Average latency at each percentile across all runs. Green = rest-api, Blue = sidecar.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'p50' as percentile, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_p END),1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service='sidecar' THEN avg_p END),1) as "sidecar" FROM (SELECT service, AVG(p50_ms) as avg_p FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service) UNION ALL SELECT 'p75', ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_p END),1), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service='sidecar' THEN avg_p END),1) FROM (SELECT service, AVG(p75_ms) as avg_p FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service) UNION ALL SELECT 'p90', ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_p END),1), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service='sidecar' THEN avg_p END),1) FROM (SELECT service, AVG(p90_ms) as avg_p FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service) UNION ALL SELECT 'p95', ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_p END),1), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service='sidecar' THEN avg_p END),1) FROM (SELECT service, AVG(p95_ms) as avg_p FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service) UNION ALL SELECT 'p99', ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_p END),1), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service='sidecar' THEN avg_p END),1) FROM (SELECT service, AVG(p99_ms) as avg_p FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service) UNION ALL SELECT 'p999', ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_p END),1), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service='sidecar' THEN avg_p END),1) FROM (SELECT service, AVG(p999_ms) as avg_p FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service)

panels.title: P99 per Run — lower & tighter is better
panels.description: P99 latency from each run, both services overlaid

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN p99_ms END), 1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN p99_ms END), 1) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Error Rate per Run — lower is better (0 is ideal)
panels.description: Total errors per run. Zero is ideal.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN errors_total END) as "rest-api", MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN errors_total END) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Summary — Median Across Runs
panels.description: Median of each metric computed independently across all runs

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT service, COUNT(*) as runs, ROUND(AVG(rps),1) as median_rps, ROUND(AVG(avg_latency_ms),1) as median_latency, ROUND(AVG(max_latency_ms),1) as median_max_latency, ROUND(AVG(p50_ms),1) as median_p50, ROUND(AVG(p99_ms),1) as median_p99, ROUND(MAX(peak_rss_mb),1) as peak_rss, ROUND(AVG(avg_cpu_pct),1) as avg_cpu, ROUND(AVG(transfer_per_sec),0) as median_transfer, SUM(total_requests) as total_reqs, SUM(errors_total) as total_errors FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service ORDER BY service

panels.title: Memory (RSS) Over Time
panels.description: RSS during baseline → load → cooldown. X axis = seconds elapsed. Green = rest-api, Blue = sidecar.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT a.elapsed_s, a.rss_mb as "rest-api", b.rss_mb as "sidecar" FROM resource_samples a LEFT JOIN resource_samples b ON a.elapsed_s = b.elapsed_s AND b.endpoint='${endpoint}' AND b.service='sidecar' WHERE a.endpoint='${endpoint}' AND a.service='rest-api' ORDER BY a.elapsed_s

panels.title: CPU Usage Over Time
panels.description: CPU % during baseline → load → cooldown. 100% = 1 core. X axis = seconds elapsed.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT a.elapsed_s, a.cpu_pct as "rest-api", b.cpu_pct as "sidecar" FROM resource_samples a LEFT JOIN resource_samples b ON a.elapsed_s = b.elapsed_s AND b.endpoint='${endpoint}' AND b.service='sidecar' WHERE a.endpoint='${endpoint}' AND a.service='rest-api' ORDER BY a.elapsed_s

panels.title: Peak RSS per Run (MB) — lower & tighter is better
panels.description: Peak memory (RSS) during each benchmark run.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN peak_rss_mb END), 1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN peak_rss_mb END), 1) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Avg CPU per Run (%) — lower & tighter is better
panels.description: Average CPU usage during each benchmark run.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_cpu_pct END), 1) as "rest-api", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN avg_cpu_pct END), 1) as "sidecar" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Memory Growth Rate (RSS delta per sample)
panels.description: Positive = memory growing, negative = shrinking. Sustained positive values under load may indicate a memory leak.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.elapsed_s, ROUND((r.rss_mb - rp.rss_mb), 3) as "rest-api", ROUND((s.rss_mb - sp.rss_mb), 3) as "sidecar" FROM resource_samples r JOIN resource_samples rp ON r.elapsed_s = rp.elapsed_s + 1 AND rp.service='rest-api' AND rp.endpoint='${endpoint}' AND rp.session_id = r.session_id LEFT JOIN resource_samples s ON r.elapsed_s = s.elapsed_s AND s.service='sidecar' AND s.endpoint='${endpoint}' LEFT JOIN resource_samples sp ON s.elapsed_s = sp.elapsed_s + 1 AND sp.service='sidecar' AND sp.endpoint='${endpoint}' AND sp.session_id = s.session_id WHERE r.endpoint='${endpoint}' AND r.service='rest-api' ORDER BY r.elapsed_s

SELECT service || ' Start RSS' as metric, ROUND(start_rss_mb, 1) as value FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service UNION ALL SELECT service || ' Peak RSS', ROUND(MAX(peak_rss_mb), 1) FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service UNION ALL SELECT service || ' End RSS', ROUND(end_rss_mb, 1) FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service UNION ALL SELECT service || ' Avg CPU %', ROUND(avg_cpu_pct, 1) FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service UNION ALL SELECT service || ' Peak CPU %', ROUND(peak_cpu_pct, 1) FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY service

panels.title: Throughput vs Memory per Run
panels.description: RPS and Peak RSS overlaid per run. Higher RPS with lower memory = more efficient.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN rps END), 1) as "rest-api RPS", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN rps END), 1) as "sidecar RPS", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN peak_rss_mb END), 1) as "rest-api RSS", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN peak_rss_mb END), 1) as "sidecar RSS" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Throughput vs CPU per Run
panels.description: RPS and Avg CPU overlaid per run. Higher RPS with lower CPU = more efficient.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN rps END), 1) as "rest-api RPS", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN rps END), 1) as "sidecar RPS", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN avg_cpu_pct END), 1) as "rest-api CPU", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN avg_cpu_pct END), 1) as "sidecar CPU" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: Latency vs Memory per Run
panels.description: P99 latency and Peak RSS overlaid per run. Lower latency with lower memory = more efficient.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'Run ' || run_number as run, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN p99_ms END), 1) as "rest-api P99", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN p99_ms END), 1) as "sidecar P99", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service LIKE '%rest-api%' THEN peak_rss_mb END), 1) as "rest-api RSS", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN service = 'sidecar' THEN peak_rss_mb END), 1) as "sidecar RSS" FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' GROUP BY run_number ORDER BY run_number

panels.title: CPU vs Memory — rest-api
panels.description: Dual axis: CPU (left) and RSS (right). Shows how memory grows with CPU load.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT elapsed_s, cpu_pct as "CPU %", rss_mb as "RSS (MB)" FROM resource_samples WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND service='rest-api' ORDER BY elapsed_s
SELECT elapsed_s, cpu_pct as "CPU %", rss_mb as "RSS (MB)" FROM resource_samples WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND service='sidecar' ORDER BY elapsed_s

SELECT service, run_number as run, rps, avg_latency_ms, max_latency_ms, p50_ms, p99_ms, p999_ms, total_requests, errors_total as errors, peak_rss_mb, avg_cpu_pct, peak_cpu_pct, ROUND(transfer_per_sec, 0) as transfer_per_sec, CASE WHEN total_requests > 0 THEN ROUND(bytes * 1.0 / total_requests, 0) ELSE 0 END as avg_resp_bytes FROM benchmark_runs WHERE endpoint='${endpoint}' AND scenario='${scenario}' ORDER BY service, run_number
